subject: SIG questionnaire request — NovaBank security intake
messages:
From: Lucas Reed <security@novabank.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:18 -0000
Subject: SIG request and timeline

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this — NovaBank is running a routine vendor SIG and we need Redwood to complete the Standardized Information Gathering (SIG) questionnaire. Attached is the initial request packet (NovaBank_SIG_Request_20270328.pdf).

High-level asks:
- Complete the SIG spreadsheet (we'll upload) and flag any questions you can't answer.
- Provide evidence (PDF/exports) for the sections we mark as "in-scope" (Access Control, Change Management, Data Protection).
- We have a compliance window: need completed questionnaire and evidence by EOD 2027-04-07.

Can you confirm an internal owner for each major section and whether you can meet the date? If not, please propose a staggered delivery with dates.

I'll be on standby for a 30–45 minute intake call tomorrow afternoon if helpful.

Thanks,
Lucas Reed
Senior InfoSec Analyst, NovaBank
security@novabank.com

Attachment: NovaBank_SIG_Request_20270328.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.com, irene.choi@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: Lucas Reed <security@novabank.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 11:03:44 -0000
Subject: Re: SIG request and timeline

Folks —

Looping you in for intake. NovaBank needs the SIG + evidence by 2027-04-07 (tight but doable if we triage). I propose the following assignments for primary ownership (we'll treat these as stewards responsible for collecting artifacts and completing the answers):

Proposed owners (first pass):
- Access Control (AC): Marissa Cole — collect IAM screenshots, role lists, MFA policy, service account inventory. Target: 2027-04-04.
- Change Management (CM): Marcus Lin — change logs, approval workflow doc, patching cadence. Target: 2027-04-05.
- Data Protection (DP): Irene Choi — encryption at rest/in transit docs, key rotation notes, data classification map. Target: 2027-04-05.
- Business Continuity / DR (BC/DR): Jonas Weber (me) — tabletop summaries, RPO/RTO targets. Target: 2027-04-06.

I've attached a quick spreadsheet with a section-to-owner mapping and initial evidence checklist (sig-section-ownership-draft.xlsx). Please: 1) confirm you can take the section, 2) list any known evidence gaps inline in the spreadsheet, and 3) add the drive link(s) where you'll place artifacts.

I'll schedule a 30-minute intake war room for tomorrow 15:00 PT — please accept if that works.

Thanks — I'll coordinate final submission to Lucas once we've compiled everything.

— Jonas
VP, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sig-section-ownership-draft.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 08:45:10 -0000
Subject: Re: SIG request and timeline

Thanks Jonas — confirmed on AC. Quick notes after scanning the NovaBank packet:

- I'll own Access Control. Evidence I will drop in Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3SigIntakeNovabank/ACCESS.
- Immediate gaps: we need a consolidated service-account inventory (we have per-project lists but not a single export). I can produce an export by 2027-04-02 but will need a quick pass from infra to validate.
- MFA evidence: screenshots of Okta policy and a recent push notification log sample. I have Okta screenshots; Marcus, can you share the recent push log export or point me to the SRE who can run it?

I added comments to the spreadsheet for items I'm short on. If anyone can pre-seed the service-account CSV template, that will speed things.

-Marissa
Director, Cloud Security
Redwood Inference

Confirmed on Data Protection. A couple of clarifying asks from the NovaBank packet:

1) They expect specific KMS evidence: key policy docs + key rotation log for the last 12 months. We can provide key metadata and rotation notes from our KMS (Hashicorp Vault) exports. I'll generate a filtered rotation log (redacted) and drop it by 2027-04-04.
2) Data classification map: we have a living spreadsheet in /security/docs — I'll snapshot and mark rows that apply to NovaBank's scope.

I'll add the artifact list to the Drive folder under /DP and note which items require approvals before external submission (e.g., key metadata that might include internal IDs).

I attached a one-line export example to show format (access-control-export.csv) so teams can align columns.

Thanks — Irene
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: SIG request and timeline — proposed delivery plan

Lucas / NovaBank —

Thanks for the packet and for the patience while we triaged. We have assigned internal stewards and created a single evidence staging Drive folder. High-level delivery plan below:

- Access Control (Marissa Cole): partial evidence by 2027-04-02, final by 2027-04-04.
- Change Management (Marcus Lin): evidence by 2027-04-05.
- Data Protection (Irene Choi): evidence by 2027-04-04 (KMS rotation log will be redacted).
- BC/DR (Jonas Weber): summary and tabletop by 2027-04-06.

We will upload artifacts into this shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3SigIntakeNovabank. I've also attached a short table-of-contents for the evidence pack (SIG-evidence-pack-TOC.pdf) to make ingestion easier on your side.

If NovaBank can accept a staggered submission (AC + DP by 04/04; CM by 04/05; BC/DR by 04/06) that would help us validate items with minimal risk. If the 04/07 hard deadline is firm for the full deliverable, we can prioritize and put interim answers in the spreadsheet and mark evidence 'pending — submit by 04/07'.

Please let us know if you prefer a 30-minute sync to walk through the folder tomorrow — happy to join.

Best,
Jonas Weber
VP, Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SIG-evidence-pack-TOC.pdf
